entries.name: Push-up
entries.summary: Three drawn positions of a push-up, seen from the side.

provenance.positions: Authored for this repository from its own curated execution instructions and coaching cues for movement_id 16 (packages/core-db/src/schema/010_movement_library.sql, 025_movement_coaching_content.sql).
instructionAgreement: top — "set one straight line from head to heels"; hips, shoulders and heels are drawn on one line in every frame.
descent — "Lower the chest as one unit"; the elbow stays behind the wrist, as the cue "Track the elbows behind the wrists" asks.
bottom — "if the hips and chest arrive separately, raise the hands"; the body line stays rigid at the bottom.
provenance.artwork: No third-party artwork. Every frame is a list of joint coordinates in this file, drawn at runtime from plain React Native views.
provenance.licence: Original work created for this repository; covered by the repository licence.

entries.reviewNotes: Side view only, hands fixed on the floor. Hand width, shoulder blade position and neck position are not visible from this angle. No qualified technique reviewer has signed this off yet.
entries.limitations: The drawing cannot show how far the elbows flare away from the ribs, which is the fault the cues care about most.

frames.caption: Top: one straight line from head to heels, arms long
Halfway down: the chest leads, elbows tracking behind the wrists
Bottom: chest close to the floor, hips and chest arriving together

entries.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the ankle planted on the drawn box at (20, 58) tilts the rigid line head-down (the feet 26 units above the floor) while the shoulder rides the arm circle (upper 12.5 / fore 12.0) from a 22-unit span to 12 at the bottom. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a feet-elevated push-up on a box.

frames.caption: Set your feet on the box and your hands on the floor just wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor as one rigid line.
Keep the hips locked into the plank at the bottom.
Press back to long arms without the hips piking.
Finish with the chest leading and the chin packed.

entries.name: Push Up to Side Plank
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing was against this text: the turn onto one hand and the reach to the ceiling barely showed. Source-bound side-view draft on a body that can roll about its own length: a push-up on the toes with the body in one straight line, then, pressing up, the body rolls onto its far hand and far foot until the hips and shoulders are stacked, and the near arm sweeps out and up until it points straight at the ceiling; a hold, and the hand returns to the floor. The planted hand and foot do not move. One side is shown; the last caption carries the turn to the other side. Not drawn: the hands just outside shoulder width, which a side view cannot show.
entries.summary: From a push-up on the toes, press up and turn onto one hand with the body in one straight line, reaching the other arm to the ceiling, then return the hand to the floor and turn to the other side next time.

frames.caption: Start in a push-up position on the toes with the hands just outside shoulder width.
Lower into a push-up with the body straight.
As you press up, shift onto one hand and turn the body, reaching the other arm to the ceiling.
Body in one straight line. Reach the top hand to the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor under control.
Do another push-up and turn to the other side.

entries.name: Push-Up Wide
entries.reason: Own drawn frames: the same rigid-line push-up chain with the elbow solve flipped to the flared side (the elbows ride above the wrist line instead of behind it), which is what a wide grip projects to in a side elevation. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a wide-grip push-up.

frames.caption: Set the hands wide on the floor with the chest open.
Lower with the shoulder blades set and the elbows flared.
Stay wide through the bottom of the range.
Press through the same line every rep.
Finish tall with the wrists stacked over the press line.

entries.name: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 24 degrees so the dumbbell standing vertically on its end, both hands placed together on top of it, the rigid straight body line on the toes, and the elbows brushing close to the ribs as the chest lowers toward the hands all read clearly: setting a rigid push-up position on the toes with both hands on top of an end-standing dumbbell, bending the elbows close to the body to lower the chest toward the hands, and pressing back up until the arms are straight.
entries.summary: With a dumbbell stood on its end and both hands on top of it in a rigid push-up position on the toes, bend the elbows close to the body to lower the chest toward the hands, then press back up until the arms are straight.

frames.caption: Stand a dumbbell on its end, place both hands on the top of it, and set a push-up position on the toes with the arms straight and the body rigid.
Bend the elbows, keeping them close to the body so they brush the ribs, while pressing the dumbbell into the floor.
Lower the chest toward the hands while keeping the body rigid with the hips level with the shoulders.
Press back up from the top of the standing dumbbell while keeping the elbows close to the ribs.
Return to the top push-up position with the arms straight and the body rigid.

entries.name: Clock Push-Up
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 32 degrees so the shoulder-width hand placement, the straight body line from toes to shoulders, the explosive push where both hands leave the floor, the lateral step turning the body around the circle, the soft bent-elbow landing, and the straight-arm reset all read clearly: lowering the chest in a straight-line push-up, pushing up fast so the hands leave the floor, landing a short step to one side with soft bent elbows while turning the body slightly, and resetting the straight body line.
entries.summary: Starting in a straight-line push-up position with hands about shoulder-width apart, lower the chest toward the floor, push up fast enough for the hands to leave the floor and land a short step to one side with soft elbows while turning the body slightly, then reset the straight body line and repeat around the circle.

frames.caption: Start in a push-up position with the hands about shoulder-width apart and the body in one straight line.
Lower the chest toward the floor while keeping the body in one straight line.
Push the floor away fast enough for the hands to leave the floor.
Land a short step to one side, turning the body slightly, and land softly with bent elbows.
Reset the straight body line and straight arms at the new position.
Push up fast again to travel back and work around the circle.
Land softly and reset the straight body line back where you started.
